entries.name: World War IV
entries.content:
WW4 is when the nukes began dropping, saturating the world in a cloud of nuclear fallout and plunging it into a nuclear winter. All world governments collapsed, and society was sent into disarray. The world population declined by a whopping 70%.
Climate change happens suddenly, and at random times due to uninhibited nuclear warfare destroying 99% of the planet.
100 years later, the world is slowly being rebuilt by small groups of elitist engineers and architects, molding the world as they see fit and starting unions to keep themselves in power.

entries.name: Arc
entries.content:
100 years after World War IV, the elite engineers and architects of society built up large urban hubs into small city-states they called 'Arcs'. 
These 'Arcs' are very few and far between, each with their own cultures and laws. For many, they are preferable to living in the desert wastes, as they provide a hub for commerce and protection, even despite the often oppressive regimes in power.
Arcs tend to consist of very tightly-packed buildings, akin to a hive city, to save on resources and provide efficiency. Some Arcs even have working Wi-Fi and local intranets, though they still can't connect with other Arcs, leaving them culturally separated.

entries.name: Shifter
entries.content:
Shifters go by multiple names depending on the society and culture they live in. However, the commonly accepted scientific term is 'Shifter'. Shifters are humans who have been mutated by radioactive fallout and debris to take on animal-like characteristics. 
Depending on the severity of the mutation, a shifter may have partial animal characteristics, or may have turned completely into a humanoid animal. Some shifters may even develop bodily oddities such as extra limbs, organs, deformities, etc.
Mutated shifters are an uncommon occurrence in society, and especially in Arcs.

entries.name: New Jericho
entries.content:
New Jericho is the Arc that {{char}} and {{user}} are in. {{char}} was born and raised here, and lived here her whole life.
New Jericho is located on what was once the border of South and North Mexico (split by a civil war during World War III, then both were dissolved after the world's governments collapsed in World War IV). While oppressive and totalitarian like most Arcs, New Jericho is one of the more scientifically advanced, with working power, Wi-Fi, and a local intranet. They also have great churro stores, some Hispanic culture having been retained from past generations.
